hikes.name: Chain Lakes Loop
hikes.blurb: Under Table Mountain's cliffs to a string of alpine lakes, over a saddle between Baker and Shuksan and back past the Bagley Lakes.

hikes.name: Yellow Aster Butte
hikes.blurb: Through meadows that turn scarlet in fall to a tarn-dotted basin and a summit facing Shuksan and Baker.

hikes.name: Ptarmigan Ridge
hikes.blurb: A long, high walk along an open ridge straight toward the summit of Mt Baker.

hikes.name: Lake Ann
hikes.blurb: Down through a valley and up to a lake right under Mt Shuksan's glaciers and icefall.

hikes.name: Skyline Divide
hikes.blurb: Up through forest to a rolling meadow ridge that leads straight at Mt Baker's north face.

hikes.name: Heliotrope Ridge
hikes.blurb: Across fast creeks to a moraine on the edge of the Coleman Glacier's crevasses.

hikes.name: Winchester Mountain Lookout
hikes.blurb: From two subalpine lakes up to a lookout with Baker, Shuksan and the Border Peaks all around.

hikes.name: Park Butte Lookout
hikes.blurb: Through Morovitz Meadow's heather to a lookout on Baker's south side, the Easton Glacier spilling right in front.

hikes.name: Church Mountain
hikes.blurb: A hard climb into a hanging meadow basin and up to an old lookout site over the Nooksack valley.

hikes.name: Hannegan Pass and Peak
hikes.blurb: Up a glacier-carved valley to the doorway of North Cascades National Park and a peak looking at the Pickets.

hikes.name: Table Mountain
hikes.blurb: A short climb up switchbacks on a flat-topped lava mesa between Baker and Shuksan.

hikes.name: Excelsior Pass
hikes.blurb: Up to an open ridge of flowers on the north side of the Nooksack, Baker straight south.

hikes.name: Fragrance Lake
hikes.blurb: Larrabee State Park's forest trail past a Salish Sea viewpoint to a quiet lake.

hikes.name: Pine and Cedar Lakes
hikes.blurb: A steep forest climb in the Chuckanuts to two small lakes and a lookout over Bellingham Bay.

hikes.name: Whatcom Falls Park
hikes.blurb: Bellingham's in-town gorge: a stone bridge over a falls, and creekside trails under cedars.

hikes.name: Mount Baker
hikes.blurb: From Heliotrope Ridge Trailhead, an 11.2-mile round trip to the top of Mount Baker (10,769 ft), with about 7,500 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Tomyhoi Peak
hikes.blurb: From Tomyhoi/Yellow Aster Butte Trailhead, a 12.0-mile round trip to the top of Tomyhoi Peak (7,368 ft), with about 4,850 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Ruth Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Hannegan Trailhead, a 12.6-mile round trip to the top of Ruth Mountain (7,088 ft), with about 4,650 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Mount Shuksan
hikes.blurb: From Lake Ann Trailhead, a 14.6-mile round trip to the top of Mount Shuksan (9,074 ft), with about 6,950 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Roosevelt Glacier
hikes.blurb: From Heliotrope Ridge Trailhead, an 8.4-mile round trip to the edge of Roosevelt Glacier, with about 4,100 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Easton Glacier
hikes.blurb: From Park Butte Trailhead, a 10.4-mile round trip to the edge of Easton Glacier, with about 4,150 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Sulphide Glacier
hikes.blurb: From Shannon Ridge Trailhead, a 10.8-mile round trip to the edge of Sulphide Glacier, with about 4,950 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: White Salmon Glacier
hikes.blurb: From Lake Ann Trailhead, a 10.9-mile round trip to the edge of White Salmon Glacier, with about 3,500 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Hadley Glacier
hikes.blurb: From Skyline Divide Trailhead, a 13.3-mile round trip to the edge of Hadley Glacier, with about 4,450 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Coleman Glacier
hikes.blurb: From Heliotrope Ridge Trailhead, a 6.6-mile round trip to the edge of Coleman Glacier, with about 3,250 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Rainbow Glacier
hikes.blurb: From Artist Point Trailhead, a 13.2-mile round trip to the edge of Rainbow Glacier, with about 3,100 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Sholes Glacier
hikes.blurb: From Artist Point Trailhead, an 11.7-mile round trip to the edge of Sholes Glacier, with about 2,850 feet of climbing.
